opportunities.title: Fulbright Scholar Awards to the USA (All Disciplines and Partner Awards)

amount.raw: Monthly stipends vary by award (e.g. Elon $5,000/month; RCS England £2,275/month; Rutgers $5,000/month plus housing and travel grant up to £1,500)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK citizens (resident anywhere except the US) or Irish citizens normally resident in Northern Ireland; dual UK nationals (except with the US); non-UK citizens based in and committed to a career in the UK who cannot apply through their country of citizenship. Must hold a PhD in a relevant subject (or have it before grant start) or equivalent professional degree/experience. Ineligible: US citizens/dual US citizens, green card holders, permanent US residents, those resident in the US for 5+ years in the previous 6 years.
opportunities.summary: Fulbright Visiting Scholar Awards provide the only scholarships for UK-based academics and other professionals to lecture and/or research in any discipline at any accredited US university. Grant periods typically last 3-6 months (some up to an academic year). Includes generous monthly stipends, sickness/accident coverage, logistical and visa support, cultural enrichment, and academic journal database packages. Individual awards include All Disciplines, Elon University, Royal College of Surgeons of England, Rutgers University-Newark, Royal Society of Edinburgh, and the Fulbright-National Archives Heritage Science Fellowship.
